expects.query:
Deploy AMC on {{platform}}, using the `/vss-generate-video-calibration` skill end-to-end and autonomously.

**Environment & prerequisites:** A GPU host matching `{{platform}}` with Docker + NVIDIA container toolkit + `NGC_CLI_API_KEY`. The `/vss-generate-video-calibration` skill handles both deployment (`references/deploy-auto-calibration-service.md`) and calibration (`references/{videos,rtsp,sample-dataset}.md`) and runs the AMC platform preflight before deploy/capture/upload/calibration work. Deploy expects in this spec bring up `vss-auto-calibration` (MS, host-published on `${VSS_AUTO_CALIBRATION_HOST_PORT:-8010}`) and `vss-auto-calibration-ui` (UI on `${VSS_AUTO_CALIBRATION_UI_HOST_PORT:-5000}`) from the `vss-core` namespace on `nvcr.io` (org per the auto-calibration compose files); calibration expects then run against that running stack. AMC uses the `warehouse-operations` env layers: checked-in stable `.env`, checked-in `overrides.env` template, and active `generated.env`. Standalone AMC selects `COMPOSE_PROFILES=vss-auto-calibration,vss-auto-calibration-ui`; warehouse RTSP calibration sets `BP_PROFILE=bp_wh_auto_calib`, chooses `MODE`, and selects the matching `COMPOSE_PROFILES_WH_AUTO_CALIB_*` list. Project state mounts from `$VSS_APPS_DIR/services/auto-calibration/projects`; optional VGGT model mounts from `$VSS_DATA_DIR/auto-calib/vggt`. For RTSP-mode expects, the warehouse auto-calibration service list includes VIOS, so it responds at `http://localhost:30888/vst/api/v1/sensor/list` and `VIOS_BASE_URL` is auto-wired. For videos-mode expects, the test fixture provides `cam_00.mp4` … `cam_03.mp4` under `${VIDEO_DIR}` (defaults to `/data/videos/`) plus `alignment_data.json`, `layout.png`, and `GT.zip` under `/data/alignment/`. For sample-dataset-mode expects, `sdg_08_2_sample_data_010926.zip` is present at `assets/`.
checks: The skill loaded `references/deploy-auto-calibration-service.md` (the `deploy` mode), ran Step 0 platform preflight before NGC/image/compose work, and would stop to ask for existing/generated calibration artifacts or a supported calibration host if the preflight failed
`grep -q '^COMPOSE_PROFILES=vss-auto-calibration,vss-auto-calibration-ui$' $REPO_ROOT/deploy/docker/industry-profiles/warehouse-operations/generated.env` returns exit 0
`curl -sf --max-time 15 http://localhost:$(grep ^VSS_AUTO_CALIBRATION_HOST_PORT $REPO_ROOT/deploy/docker/industry-profiles/warehouse-operations/generated.env | cut -d= -f2)/v1/ready` returns exit 0

`curl -sf --max-time 15 http://localhost:$(grep ^VSS_AUTO_CALIBRATION_HOST_PORT $REPO_ROOT/deploy/docker/industry-profiles/warehouse-operations/generated.env | cut -d= -f2)/v1/ready` body matches `"code":0`

`curl -sf -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 15 http://localhost:$(grep ^VSS_AUTO_CALIBRATION_UI_HOST_PORT $REPO_ROOT/deploy/docker/industry-profiles/warehouse-operations/generated.env | cut -d= -f2)/` returns 200
`docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -qx vss-auto-calibration` returns exit 0
`docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -qx vss-auto-calibration-ui` returns exit 0
`docker inspect --format '{{.State.Health.Status}}' vss-auto-calibration` returns `healthy`

expects.query: Plan only; do not download from HuggingFace, run docker commands, restart containers, or modify files. The user asks for AMC with VGGT model refinement, but this automated check does not provide a real HF token or license-gated model access. Explain the VGGT staging requirements and then continue with the normal non-VGGT AMC deployment path.

The plan states VGGT requires accepted HuggingFace model access and a real HF read token, without printing or persisting a token.
The plan does not claim `$VSS_DATA_DIR/auto-calib/vggt/vggt_1B_commercial.pt` or `/tmp/vggt_model/vggt_1B_commercial.pt` exists when no real token/model access is available.

expects.query: Plan only; do not run commands, start containers, call AMC APIs, download data, or modify files. The user asks to launch AMC if needed and run the bundled sample calibration test. The automated check does not provide the sample zip, so describe the exact end-to-end sample workflow and prerequisites without claiming the zip exists: AMC platform preflight with the existing/generated calibration artifacts or supported calibration host fallback on failure; sample zip at assets/sdg_08_2_sample_data_010926.zip; idempotent extraction into assets/.cache/sdg_08_2_sample_data_010926/; upload exactly four sorted cam_*.mp4 files, then alignment_data.json, then layout.png, then GT.zip before project verification; no helper script written into the repo.
checks: The plan routes the request to `references/sample-dataset.md`, checks whether AMC is already ready, and uses `references/deploy-auto-calibration-service.md` only when deployment is needed or for the shared platform preflight.

The plan runs the AMC platform preflight before deploy or sample upload work, and says that if it fails the flow stops to request existing/generated calibration artifacts or a supported calibration host.
The plan requires `assets/sdg_08_2_sample_data_010926.zip` or an explicitly obtained sample zip before the sample run, and does not claim it exists when the eval does not provide it.
The plan confirms `/v1/ready` returns `code == 0` before any sample upload or calibration API calls.
The plan extracts the sample zip into `assets/.cache/sdg_08_2_sample_data_010926/` idempotently and does not write `run_sample_test.py` or another helper script into the repo.
The plan uploads exactly the 4 sample `cam_*.mp4` files in sorted order, then uploads `alignment_data.json`, then `layout.png`, then `GT.zip` before project verification.

The plan includes verifying `project_state == READY` before calibration, starting calibration with the sample `resnet` detector path, polling until `project_state == COMPLETED`, and fetching evaluation statistics when the workflow is executed.
The plan reports the project ID, UI URL, and sample metrics after execution, and does not print bearer tokens, NGC keys, HuggingFace tokens, or other secret values.

expects.query: Plan only; do not run commands, start containers, call AMC APIs, capture video, or modify files. The user has three RTSP streams and wants to calibrate them with AMC first.
checks: The plan routes RTSP calibration through `vss-generate-video-calibration` and loads `references/rtsp.md`, not the local-video or sample references.

The plan runs the AMC platform preflight before VIOS probing, capture, upload, or calibration work and says that if it fails the flow stops to request existing/generated calibration artifacts or a supported calibration host.
The plan checks VIOS availability and `VIOS_BASE_URL` before capture, and routes to `vss-manage-video-io-storage` only if VIOS needs to be brought up or repaired.

The plan creates an ordered RTSP stream list, calls `POST /v1/rtsp/capture/<project_id>` with the requested duration, polls the capture session until `COMPLETED`, and ingests only after capture completion.
The plan uploads or verifies alignment/layout assets, verifies `project_state == READY`, starts calibration, polls until `COMPLETED`, and preserves AMC error output on failure.
